title: Voltage fluctuations hit Ilocos Norte amid low power delivery from NGCP

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Residents in Ilocos Norte experienced fluctuating electricity supply on Thursday (Oct. 8) after the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) delivered low voltage to the province, according to the Ilocos Norte Electric Cooperative Inc. (INEC). In an advisory, INEC said it received reports from consumers about the fluctuating power supply and conducted an investigation of its lines and system. READ: Ilocos power utility backs nuke option The cooperative said the problem began around 10:45 a.m. and was traced to low-voltage delivery from NGCP.
